facts.text: Serve the drink for Jobu when Cerrano steps up to bat.
facts.why: In the ninth Cerrano steps up, berates Jobu at the plate and then homers, after the locker room call that Jobu needs a refill, so the cue fits.

facts.text: Lou Brown's order, tyre salesman's hours.
facts.why: Donovan phones Lou Brown at Tire World to offer him the job, so the tyre salesman line is true; the drink is a menu joke.

vibe.verdict: A good Cleveland bar with Jobu's rum and Wild Thing pie, but it leans on bar snacks more than the film's famous gags.
missing: Wild Thing walking out to the song (the bullpen)
Harry Doyle's Die Hard Night (the booth)
Willie Mays Hayes and the American Express slide (the tux scene)
The red tag in the locker (spring training)
